# Table.RemoveMatchingRows

```m
Table.RemoveMatchingRows(table as table, rows as list, optional equationCriteria as any) as table
```

Removes all occurrences of the specified rows from the table.

*Description: Microsoft, MIT ([THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../../../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)).*

Reference: [Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powerquery-m/table-removematchingrows)

| `rows` | `list` | no |
| `equationCriteria` | `any` | yes |
